refsynopsisdiv.programlisting: enum SilikoError { SilikoErrorNone = 0, SilikoErrorNullObject, SilikoErrorSyntax, SilikoErrorZeroDivision, SilikoErrorFunctionName, SilikoErrorFunctionArguments, SilikoErrorDomain, SilikoErrorRange };

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoError enumeration represents any error codes for errors encountered or produced by Siliko Core during parsing or evaluation.

listitem.para: SilikoErrorNone: An error state was checked, but no error condition exists.
SilikoErrorNullObject: A NULL value was passed to one of Siliko Core's API functions.
SilikoErrorSyntax: A syntax error was encountered while parsing.
SilikoErrorZeroDivision: An attempt to divide by zero was encountered while evaluating.
SilikoErrorFunctionName: A SilikoEngine was unable to locate a function used in an expression during evaluation.
SilikoErrorFunctionArguments: A function reported that the wrong number of arguments was passed to it.
SilikoErrorDomain: A function encountered a domain error.
SilikoErrorRange: A function encountered a range error.
